nodes.question: What type of GPS devices were used in 2022 and 2023 for tracking purposes?
nodes.answer: In 2022, Lotek PinPoint Cell Solar 2G GPS-GSM devices were used, and in 2023, Interrex/Druid Mini solar-powered 2G GPS-GSM devices were utilized.
